decisions.reason: A flanged dismantling joint is a standard complementary piping component with steady demand from water and industrial projects, so the firm is unlikely to withdraw it one year after launch even though the website only mentions it.
The ceiling or floor pipe bracket has its own product page, fits the firm's core fabricated-metal pipe support range, and needs little ongoing investment, so dropping it soon is improbable.
The pipe support bracket is a dedicated, prominently presented item in the firm's core bracket portfolio, and such low-cost catalogue products are typically kept for many years.
